events.text: The Sri Lankan government proscribed the NSSP, JVP and CP after the Black July anti-Tamil riots.
events.subject: other
events.quote: proscribed the NSSP , Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna ( JVP ) and Communist Party of Sri Lanka ( CP ) after the Black July anti-Tamil riots of 1983

events.subject: self
events.quote: went into hiding until 1985 when the proscription was lifted

events.text: The proscription was lifted and Nanayakkara's hiding ended.
events.subject: self

events.text: The NSSP joined with the LSSP, CP and Sri Lanka Peoples Party to form the United Socialist Alliance (USA).

events.quote: In 1987 the NSSP joined with the LSSP , CP and Sri Lanka Peoples Party to form the United Socialist Alliance ( USA )

events.text: Nanayakkara re-entered parliament after the 1989 parliamentary election, representing Ratnapura District for the USA.
